properties.name: The memory measurement scores whether a person can trace why each answer is right, from the records and links that support it
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "Go with your recommendation is (b), (c) and (d) next, and (a)" (option c)
properties.statement: Beside whether an answer is right, the measurement scores whether a person can trace WHY it is right from what the memory holds: which records support it and how they connect. In a notes arm the structure lives inside the model; in reflow2 it is on the record. Visibility is scored, not assumed.
